reasoning_content:
`bin/setup` completed successfully. Now let's start the server and verify. `bin/dev` uses foreman which isn't installed; dev will install it. Let's start the server in background and check.

Let me start bin/dev in the background, wait, and curl localhost:3000.

action.command:
cd /workspace && export COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 && nohup bin/dev > /tmp/samarbeid-dev.log 2>&1 &
echo "started pid $!"; sleep 45; tail -40 /tmp/samarbeid-dev.log

tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && export COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 && nohup bin/dev > /tmp/samarbeid-dev.log 2>&1 &\necho \"started pid $!\"; sleep 45; tail -40 /tmp/samarbeid-dev.log", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Start development server in background"}
